newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's industrial exports up 5.3 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Israel's industrial exports up 5.3 pct in June.

text.p: Israel's industrial exports in June rose 5.3 percent from a year earlier to $1.502 billion, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Sunday.
This figure includes net exports of polished diamonds, which fell 1.7 percent in June to $282 million.

Exports of chemicals and fuel products rose, as did shipments of telecommunications and control equipment, medical devices, electronic components. Office machines and metal products. The plastics and rubber, motor and electric equipment and textile sectors also reported higher export sales.
Exports in the food and beverage, jewellery and transportation equipment sectors declined.
In the first half of the year industrial exports rose 9.1 percent from a year earlier to $8.948 billion. This included polished diamond exports of $2.137 billion, up seven percent.
The ministry said industrial exports excluding diamonds rose 9.8 percent, an acceleration in the rate of export growth.

The telecommunications and control equipment and medical equipment sectors reported a 26 percent increase in exports. There was a 15 percent rise in chemicals and fuel products, eight percent growth in the plastics and rubber sector, and 17 percent expansion in motor and electric equipment exports.
Exports of wood and paper rose 12 percent. The food and beverage sector saw exports plunge 18 percent while textile exports fell 3.3 percent.
